text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Aw, man, I lost... Ah, well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it...
I was so sure I could
win...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance races are my specialty.
How could I
have lost control over my
breathing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It must have been the weight of running
my first
Classic Triple Crown race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I totally get that feeling. You
can't run a
Triple Crown race like you
would any other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I bet it happens to everyone, so don't
beat
yourself up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? You may be right... but
even so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniffle... Ughhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is my own fault. I didn't prepare
enough... No
matter the excuse, it's no
consolation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wanted to overcome any obstacle and win today... I just... wanted to... win here... Sob...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, McQueen... I can't believe she
wanted to win
that badly...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I lost today too, same as her. But...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Did I really wanna win so bad that I
would've
cried if I didn't? I wonder...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I realized something after
running in
the Kikuka Sho today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I really am built a little different than
the other
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like... I feel like I don't have the same
passion for
racing. Or the same strength
to dream big.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ryan ran all of the Classic Triple Crown
races with
a sense of duty to win every
single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And McQueen's attitude toward the race
today
was really amazing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then there's me. All I was thinking about
was
having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me if I was taking the race as
seriously
as them, well... I can't really say
I was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I like running, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't know where exactly I should be running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aaanyway, that just popped into my
head! It's not
like I'm seriously worried
about where I belong or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's enough of that! Oh, right, you
gonna eat
that spicy pudding in the
fridge? I've gotten
kinda addicted to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer changes the subject and
heads for
the refrigerator. It seems she
hasn't decided how
she feels yet.
